question: I deposited cash at an ATM and the money never showed up in my account
A collection account showed up on my credit report for a debt I never received a bill or notice about
My credit card company refused to refund fraudulent charges or a purchase I disputed
issue: Problem with a purchase shown on your statement

question: A debt collector says I owe money for a debt I already disputed or paid
My student loan servicer mishandled my forbearance or income-driven repayment request
issue: Dealing with your lender or servicer

question: A debt collector threatened to sue me or contacted my employer about my debt
issue: Took or threatened to take negative or legal action

question: A debt collector keeps calling me at work after I asked them to stop
The bank closed my account without explaining why, or would not close it when I asked
My credit card charged me interest or fees that I should not have owed
I am locked out of my credit report and cannot get a copy from the credit bureau
issue: Unable to get your credit report or credit score

question: My bank would not refund unauthorized transactions taken from my checking account
issue: Problem with a lender or other company charging your account

question: My credit card account was closed by the issuer and I could not get it reopened
The bank never paid the sign-up bonus it promised for opening a new account
Someone used my personal information to open a bank account in my name
My credit card payment was not posted on time and I was reported late
I asked the debt collector to validate the debt and they never sent proof
The credit card promotional offer or welcome bonus was not honored as advertised
issue: Advertising and marketing, including promotional offers

question: Someone opened a credit card in my name without my knowledge
My credit card application was denied even though I have good credit
My auto loan servicer reported me late or charged fees that were wrong
My credit card issuer reported a late payment I never made and will not remove it
issue: Problem with a credit reporting company's investigation into an existing problem

question: My credit limit was cut without notice and my card was declined
My personal information was exposed in the Equifax data breach
issue: Credit monitoring or identity theft protection services

question: My car was repossessed after I fell behind on my auto loan payments
My bank charged me overdraft fees I did not expect
issue: Problem caused by your funds being low

question: There is incorrect information on my credit report that I need removed
I disputed items on my credit report and the credit bureau did not respond or investigate
issue: Problem with a credit reporting company's investigation into an existing problem

question: A company pulled my credit report without my permission
A debt collector is trying to collect a debt that is not mine
issue: Attempts to collect debt not owed
